en.summary: A 10-year-old boy named Kerim Demir disappeared after leaving his home in Bursa's İnegöl district, prompting a police response following his family's report.

en.title: Armed robbery attempt at jewelry shop: Failed to steal gold, caught by shopkeepers
en.summary: A suspect attempted to rob a jewelry store in Salihli, Manisa, wounding the shop owner and another person. The suspect fled without obtaining any gold and was apprehended by nearby merchants and handed over to police.

en.title: Male body found in Sultangazi
en.summary: An unidentified male body was discovered during an inspection at stone quarries in Istanbul's Sultangazi district following reports of a bad odor.

en.title: Male corpse found in Sultangazi quarries: Identity undetermined
en.summary: An unidentified male body was discovered in stone quarries in Sultangazi. The body was transferred to the Forensic Medicine Institute morgue for identification and autopsy procedures.

en.summary: Turkey's financial crimes authority MASAK stopped a transaction worth 2 billion lira that Hedef Yatırım Bankası was sending to a Swiss-based financial institution called Swissquote.

stories.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan'dan yatırımcılara Türkiye çağrısı: Türkiye'ye yatırım yapan hep kazançlı çıktı

en.title: President Erdoğan calls on investors: Turkey investment has always been profitable
en.summary: President Erdoğan highlighted that bilateral trade between Turkey and the United States doubled over the past decade and urged foreign investors to invest in Turkey. He emphasized Turkey's stability despite crises and stated readiness to advance cooperation with the US in energy, aviation, technology, and defense sectors.

stories.title: Karadeniz savaşı tahıl rotasını değiştirdi: Rusya buğdayı kuzeye taşıyor

en.title: Black Sea conflict shifts grain route: Russia transporting wheat northward
en.summary: Attacks on ports and shipping lines in the Black Sea have accelerated route changes in Russian grain trade. Fertilizer and coal terminals are being adapted for wheat loading, while reduced exports create new cost pressures for Turkey's flour industry, animal feed, and shipping.

stories.title: Kızıldeniz alarmı büyüyor: AB 6 gemiyi yetersiz buldu, G7 İran’a yüklendi

en.title: Red Sea alarm growing: EU finds 6 ships insufficient, G7 pressures Iran
en.summary: The European Union says its current military presence protecting commercial vessels in the Red Sea is inadequate for existing threats and seeks to increase warship numbers above 10. The G7 called on Iran to stop supporting Houthi forces, with risk in the Suez corridor escalating rather than diminishing.

stories.title: Yapay zekâ rallisi geri döndü: Küresel borsalarda ibre yukarı

en.title: Artificial intelligence rally returns: Global stock markets rise
en.summary: Technology stocks on Wall Street pushed Nasdaq to record levels while declining oil prices boosted investor risk appetite. The rally spread to Asian markets, with European and US futures opening higher.

stories.title: Altın kolay düşmüyor: Büyük yatırımcı piyasadan çıkmadı

en.title: Gold resists decline: Major investors remain in market
en.summary: Gold failed to experience the sharp decline expected despite Federal Reserve rate increases, dollar strength, and rising bond yields. With gram gold holding above 6,800 Turkish lira, investors now face two different scenarios.
